map "https://fhir.demo.smartregister.org/fhir/StructureMap/unicef-mexico-patient-registration" = 'Patient Registration'

uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/QuestionnaireReponse" as source
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Patient" as target

group PatientRegistration(source src: QuestionnaireResponse, target bundle: Bundle) {
    src -> bundle.id = uuid() "r_bundle_id";
    src -> bundle.type = 'collection' "r_bundle_type";

    //Consent given
    src.item as item where(linkId = "43f08bd6-f987-4f12-8dca-11a89a0af1e3" and answer.value.code = "373066001" ) then {
        src -> bundle.entry as entry, entry.resource = create('Patient') as caregiver then {
            src then ExtractCaregiverPatient(src, caregiver, bundle),
            ExtractEncounter(src, caregiver, bundle),
            ExtractConsent(src, caregiver, bundle) "r_extract_consent";
        } "r_extract_caregiver";
    } "r_cons_yes";

    //No consent given
    src.item as item where(linkId = "43f08bd6-f987-4f12-8dca-11a89a0af1e3" and answer.value.code = "373067005" ) then {
        src -> bundle.entry as entry, entry.resource = create("Consent") as cns then {
            src -> cns.id = uuid()  "r_cns_id";
            src -> cns.status = "rejected" "r_status_active";
            src -> cns.scope = cc("http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/consent-scope", "patient-privacy", "Privacy Consent"),
                cns.dateTime = evaluate(src, now()) "r_date_created";
            src -> cns.performer = evaluate(src, $this.generalPractitioner.first()) "r_cns_performer";
            src -> cns.organization = create('Reference') as orgRef then {
                src -> orgRef.reference = evaluate(src, 'Organization/' + $this.managingOrganization) "org";
            } "r_cns_org";
            src -> cns.source = create('Reference') as consentSource then {
                src -> consentSource.reference = evaluate(src, 'QuestionnaireResponse/' + src.id) "source";
            } "r_cns_source";
        } "r_cns_item";
    } "r_cons_no";
}

group ExtractConsent(source src : QuestionnaireResponse, source patient: Patient, target bundle: Bundle) {
    src.item as item where(linkId = "43f08bd6-f987-4f12-8dca-11a89a0af1e3") then {
        src -> bundle.entry as entry, entry.resource = create("Consent") as cns then {
            src -> cns.id = uuid()  "r_cns_id";
            src -> cns.status = "active" "r_status_active";
            src -> cns.scope = cc("http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/consent-scope", "patient-privacy", "Privacy Consent"),
                cns.dateTime = evaluate(src, now()) "r_date_created";
            src -> cns.patient = reference(patient) "r_cns_patient";
            src -> cns.performer = evaluate(src, $this.generalPractitioner.first()) "r_cns_performer";
            src -> cns.organization = create('Reference') as orgRef then {
                src -> orgRef.reference = evaluate(src, 'Organization/' + $this.managingOrganization) "org";
            } "r_cns_org";
            src -> cns.source = create('Reference') as consentSource then {
            src -> consentSource.reference = evaluate(src, 'QuestionnaireResponse/' + src.id) "source";
            } "r_cns_source";
        } "r_cns_item";
    } "r_consent";
}

group ExtractCaregiverPatient(source src: QuestionnaireResponse, target caregiver: Patient, target bundle: Bundle) {
    src -> caregiver.id = uuid() "r_patient_id";
    src -> caregiver.identifier = create('Identifier') as caregiverId1 then {
        src -> caregiverId1.value = 'Caregiver' "r_patient_identifier";
        src -> caregiverId1.use = "usual" "r_patient_identifier_use";
    } "r_patient_identifier";
    src -> caregiver.identifier = create('Identifier') as caregiverId2 then {
        src -> caregiverId2.value = evaluate(src, $this.item.where(linkId = 'caregiver-id').answer.value) "r_patient_identifier_2";
        src -> caregiverId2.use = "official" "r_patient_identifier_2_use";
    } "r_patient_identifier_2";
    src -> caregiver.active = true "r_patient_active";
    src -> caregiver.gender = evaluate(src, $this.item.where(linkId = 'sex').answer.value.code) "rule_patient_gender";
    src.item as caregiver_dob where(linkId = 'date-of-birth') then {
        caregiver_dob.answer first as caregiverBirthDateAnswer then {   
            caregiverBirthDateAnswer.value as val -> caregiver.birthDate = val "rule_patient_dob_answer";
        } "rule__first_patient_dob";
    } "rule_patient_dob";
    src.item as caregiver_age where(linkId = 'patient-age-years' and answer.value > 0) -> caregiver.birthDate = evaluate(caregiver_age, today() - (($this.answer.value * 365.5).toString() + ' days').toQuantity()) "rule_patient_age";
    src -> caregiver.name = create('HumanName') as caregiverName then {
        src -> caregiverName.given = evaluate(src, $this.item.where(linkId = 'caregiver-name').answer.value) "r_patient_name";
        src -> caregiverName.use = 'official' "r_patient_name_use";
    } "r_patient_human_name";
    src.item as nationality_details where(linkId = 'nationality-details') then { 
        src -> caregiver.address = create('Address') as caregiverAddress then {
            src -> caregiverAddress.country = evaluate(nationality_details, $this.item.where(linkId ='nationality').answer.value.display) "rule_patient_address_country";
            src -> caregiverAddress.country = evaluate(nationality_details, $this.item.where(linkId ='specific-nationality').answer.value.display) "rule_patient_address_specific";
            src -> caregiverAddress.state = evaluate(nationality_details, $this.item.where(linkId ='state').answer.value.display) "rule_patient_address_state";
            src -> caregiverAddress.use = "home" "r_patient_address_use";
            src -> caregiverAddress.type = "physical" "r_patient_address_type";
        } "rule_address";
    } "rule_nationality_details";
}

group ExtractEncounter(source src: QuestionnaireResponse, source patient: Patient, target bundle: Bundle) {
    src ->  bundle.entry as entry, entry.resource = create('Encounter') as encounter then { 
        src -> encounter.id = uuid() "r_en_id";
        src -> encounter.status = 'finished' "r_en_st";
        src -> encounter.class = c("http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-ActCode", "HH") "r_en_cls";
        src -> encounter.subject = reference(patient) "r_en_sub";
        src -> encounter.type = create('CodeableConcept') as concept then {
            src -> concept.coding = create("Coding") as coding then {
                src -> coding.system = "http://snomed.info/sct" "r_p_coding_system";
                src -> coding.code = "307782001" "r_p_coding_code";
                src -> coding.display = "Caregiver Patient Registration" "r_p_coding_display";
            } "r_p_meta_coding";
            src -> concept.text = "Caregiver Patient Registration" "r_en_typ_text";
        } "r_en_typ";
        src -> encounter.priority = create('CodeableConcept') as concept then {
            src -> concept.coding = create("Coding") as coding then {
                src -> coding.system = "http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/v3-ActPriority" "r_p_coding_system";
                src -> coding.code = "EL" "r_p_coding_code";
                src -> coding.display = "elective" "r_p_coding_display";
            } "r_p_meta_coding";
            src -> concept.text = 'elective' "r_en_prio_text";
        } "r_en_prio";
        src -> encounter.period = create('Period') as enPeriod then {
            src -> enPeriod.start = evaluate(src, now()) "r_en_per_start";
            src -> enPeriod.end = evaluate(src, now()) "r_en_per_end";
        } "r_en_per";
        src -> encounter.reasonCode = create('CodeableConcept') as concept then {
            src -> concept.coding = create("Coding") as coding then {
                src -> coding.system = "http://smartregsiter.org/" "r_p_coding_system";
                src -> coding.code = "patient_registration" "r_p_coding_code";
                src -> coding.display = "Patient Registration" "r_p_coding_display";
            } "r_p_meta_coding";
            src -> concept.text = 'Caregiver Patient Registration' "r_en_text";
        } "r_en_reason";

        src then ExtractLeaveOriginObservation(src, encounter, patient, bundle) "r_extract_leave_origin_obs";

    } "r_enc_item";
}

group ExtractLeaveOriginObservation(source src: QuestionnaireResponse, target encounter: Encounter, source patient: Patient, target bundle: Bundle) {
    src.item as item where($this.linkId.where(contains('months-since-leaving-place-of-origin')).exists() and answer.value.exists()) then {
        src -> bundle.entry as entry, entry.resource = create('Observation') as leaveOriginObservation then { 
            src -> leaveOriginObservation.id = uuid() "rule_observation_id";
            src -> leaveOriginObservation.subject = reference(patient) "rule_observation_subject";
            src -> leaveOriginObservation.encounter = reference(encounter) "rule_observation_encounter";
            src -> leaveOriginObservation.status = 'final' "rule_observation_status";
            src -> leaveOriginObservation.effective = evaluate(src, now()) "rule_observation_effective";
            src -> leaveOriginObservation.category = create('CodeableConcept') as code then {
                src -> code.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
                    src -> coding.system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' "r_leave_origin_obs_coding_system";
                    src -> coding.code = '360885002' "r_leave_origin_obs_coding_code";
                    src -> coding.display = 'Change of residence status' "r_leave_origin_obs_coding_display";
                } "r_leave_origin_obs_coding";
            } "r_leave_origin_obs_code";
            src -> leaveOriginObservation.value = evaluate(item, $this.answer.value.toInteger()) "r_leave_obs";

            src -> encounter.reasonReference = create("Reference") as encRef then {
                src -> encRef.reference = evaluate(leaveOriginObservation, "Observation/" + $this.id) "r_enc_reason_ref";
                src -> encRef.type = 'Observation' "r_enc_reason_ref_type";
            } "r_enc_reason";

        } "r_leave_origin_obs";
    } "r_leave_origin";
}
